titulo: Sum, average and values above average
enunciado: Read 6 float grades into an array, compute the sum and the average and show how many and which grades are above the average.
objetivos: Fill an array with input data
Traverse twice: once to compute and once to compare
pistas: You cannot know which grades are above average until you have read them all.
That is why you store them in an array.
Second pass: compare each grade with the average.
